about: A PHP library that reads details like title, length and format from audio and video files.

prs.title: Apple Lossless music files are read as audio
prs.broken: Apple Lossless music files were reported as video, with no audio format, sample rate or channels. Normal AAC files of the same kind were read fine.
prs.changed: These files are now read as audio, with the right format, sample rate, channels and bit depth, including high-resolution 96 kHz files.
prs.matters: Music apps and libraries built on it can now show and sort lossless music properly.
